scope: Final iteration: 22 exercises, preserving all 14 existing IDs and non-media content; local derivatives for every exercise.

license.name: Unlicense
license.declaration: Repository describes dataset and imagery as public domain; per-photo author/model release not supplied. No license claim for URJC logo or Inter.

quality: Native source dimensions are recorded per resource. Existing 850px photography from P1 is retained without upscaling; Plancha source is 1904px. Detail derivatives use at most 1600px. No universal high-density or professional technique certification claim.

performanceObservation.limitations: 12-second observation with cold cache per run; bytes count completed image requests including brand logo.
